# `content_normalize`

Normalizes Anthropic content block types for vLLM/Qwen compatibility.

## Configuration

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `max_body_bytes` | integer | no | Maximum request body size accepted by the filter. |

## Example

```yaml
filter: content_normalize
```
